description.value: Sabzi Mandi Supermarket is a 100% family-owned South Asian grocery chain with 15 locations across Canada, founded to serve BC's South Asian community with fresh produce, specialty groceries, and imported goods that were historically hard to find locally. The Nanaimo location offers cyclists access to a broad range of fresh fruits and vegetables, bulk staples, and specialty ingredients from around the world. The chain also carries household items and cooking appliances, making it a genuinely comprehensive resupply stop.
